name: voicescribe
description:
Ask your AI to turn meetings into action items, customer interviews into product plans, and lectures into study notes.

Try asking: "Transcribe all videos in my local 'Customer Interviews' folder. Combine them with my saved interviews from the past three months to create a product improvement plan. Identify recurring problems, emerging needs, and suggested priorities, with supporting quotes, sources, and timestamps."

VoiceScribe transcribes your audio and video and saves the transcripts in your personal cloud library. Your connected AI assistant can work with new files or revisit saved conversations, so you can ask what customers need, find a past decision, or build on what you already know.

Local folder uploads require a compatible agent with access to your files and the network. Supported file types and upload limits apply.

defaultPrompt: Transcribe all videos in my interview folder and use the past three months of saved interviews to draft an improvement plan.
Find recurring customer problems in my interviews from the past three months, with quotes and timestamps.
Turn my latest meeting into key decisions and action items, with sources.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.5.0 aligns MCP uploads with the website: a 6 GiB default file limit, multiple queued files, and resumable direct S3 multipart uploads through prepare_upload. The hosted MCP removes import_attachment, retains local agent uploads and separate upload authorization, and shows upload and transcription progress. Browser uploads require selecting local files in the card and keeping it open during transfer.
